coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Avalon at Mission Bay III
record.summary: Avalon at Mission Bay III, an AvalonBay apartment community whose grand opening AvalonBay announced on June 18, 2009.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- official DataSF Assessor parcel boundary (blklot 8705006), ~6093 sq m, not a hand trace or plan estimate. 353-383 King St, 260 units per secondary sources; grand opening June 18, 2009 per AvalonBay's own investor-relations press release. This is the whole site/land parcel, not just the building's rooftop -- it includes any courtyard, landscaping or parking within the lot line. The parcel is condo-mapped for ownership purposes across many individually owned per-unit lots sharing this same footprint (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents one owner and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can.
